title: A2 Bridge checkpoint
subtitle: Follow a short connected Greek narrative with discipline.
overview: At this checkpoint, demonstrate a process: identify finite verbs, connect clauses, parse participles, and state uncertainty honestly.
The goal is not instant translation. The goal is a defensible first reading that prepares you for paragraph work in A2 Core.

items.grc: καὶ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπεν ὅτι ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.
items.en: And coming to him, he said that if you are willing, you are able to cleanse me.

items.grc: ὁ δὲ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· θέλω, καθαρίσθητι.
items.en: And he, stretching out his hand, touched him and says to him, “I am willing; be cleansed.”
